svg.title: The MagicFocus tab
svg.desc: Photo of the MagicFocus tab on a CoreS3, labelled. The lens bar shows slot 3, Canon RF 24-70 2.8; holding the name locks the lens. Lidar, 0.20 m, is the distance to the subject, and Lens, 0.19 m, is where the lens is focused. Camera, here Off, is the Blackmagic camera link, Core2 only. Motor OK means the motor answers by radio. The screen also shows Speed Slow, AF: ON, Infinity, the status Autofocus on and the battery at 3.9 V.
svg.text: hold the name to lock it
